expectation: Membrane signal on nerve fibres and Schwann cells. In gut these would sit in the myenteric and submucosal plexuses as discrete ganglia and thin fibre bundles, plus some pericytes and FDCs in lymphoid follicles. Sparse, network-like, not filling whole layers.
observed: A: yellow fills the whole muscularis wall, with thin rings round submucosal vessels; mucosa dim. B, C: faint diffuse haze, no stained cells. D: smooth haze with no cell outlines. E: CD21 is uniform magenta haze, so row E tells nothing.
why: The signal fills the whole smooth-muscle compartment and the vessel walls evenly, not discrete nerves, ganglia or Schwann cells, and no specific NGFR cells show at any scale.
notes: NGFR lights the whole muscle wall and the vessel walls evenly. That looks like off-target smooth-muscle signal or autofluorescence, not enteric nerves or plexus. The close-up fields show only haze. CD21 has no cellular structure, so the co-stain row cannot help.
